_doc: Segmentation & device-class policy for netmon. zones: CIDR per network zone. device_classes: MAC (or IP) -> class (iot, camera, media, game, personal, work, server, k8s, infra). allow: internal flows that are OK (src/dst = IP, zone or class, '*' = any; ports = list of numbers or 'port/proto'). Everything else on a sensitive port, from the DMZ, or from IoT/cameras to servers/k8s/ai is a violation. Edit freely.
_doc_device_classes: Keys may be a MAC address (lower-case, colon separated; preferred, survives DHCP changes) or an IP.
